notes: §1985:XIV.3.5.4 GR5: with no data available, a) with NO DATA the RECEIVE terminates "with the indication that action is complete" and runs imperative-statement-1, b) without it "execution of the object program is suspended until data is made available", c) unknown queues or subqueues store the status key and transfer control "as if data had been made available". Receive returns DataAvailable false only when the NO DATA phrase was written (status 00, text length 0), otherwise loops waiting (awaitData or a 100 ms poll) and asks again, and any non-00 status returns DataAvailable true with identifier-1 untouched; EmitReceive selects the phrase. Probes at --std 85 (classes b, e, f): a waiter with no NO DATA phrase stayed suspended 8 s, then completed with HELLO 0005 2 after a second run unit SENT to a destination delivering to its queue; empty queue with NO DATA GO TO AFTER-8 skipped WITH DATA, status 00; unknown queue and subqueues gave 20 with WITH DATA run; an unusable mcs.json gave 91 with WITH DATA run and the receiver unchanged.

next.reason: 1985: "If the NO DATA phrase is specified in the RECEIVE statement, the RECEIVE operation is terminated ... If one or more queues"; 2023: "The 2023 RECEIVE receives a message from a server or requestor run unit; it has no NO DATA phrase and no queues or subqueues.". The 1985 communication-module RECEIVE (NO DATA phrase, MCS queues, status key) is gone. The 2023 RECEIVE is a different run-unit messaging statement and does not carry this rule.
